entities.name: Gor Sahakyan
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Gor Sahakyan is an Armenian weightlifter. He is a two-time European Champion, bronze medalist at the 2023 World Weightlifting Championships, and silver medalist at the 2025 European Weightlifting Championships.
